name: g3_m3n
prereg: G3 M3 (D18): LightGBM on out-of-fold m1_E_resB0 residuals, training-fold variable genes. Coverage rule (docs/g3_nonlinear_results.md): the *_probe run (fold 0, first 100 genes of configs/g3_variable_subset500.csv) is timed first; the full config runs if the projected 5-fold wall time is <= 4 h, otherwise the *_sub500 config. DEVIATION (logged in docs/g3_nonlinear_results.md, after the independent leakage review, before any full-M3 result): nested_es=True - the early-stopping split is the first OOF split and its training rows get M1 features/residuals from a nested OOF pass (review finding 1); the permuted control permutes only training lines within each block (review finding 2).
